channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about CJ Watson | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about CJ Watson from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Larry Bird on CJ Watson, Luis Scola
item.description:
Bird re-signed West and traded spare parts Miles Plumlee and Gerald Green along with the Pacers' lottery-protected 2014 first-round draft pick to Phoenix for power forward Luis Scola.

“Once I took the job and got back, the first guy I wanted was C.J. Watson, but Scola's the guy,”

Larry Bird on CJ Watson, Luis Scola, Nov 22, 2013. Source: USA Today Sports.

item.title: Billy King on CJ Watson
item.description:
“We are very pleased to add a veteran with the savvy and experience of C.J. Watson to our roster,”

Billy King on CJ Watson, Jul 14, 2012. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Jared Karnes on CJ Watson
item.description:
Tim Bontemps:Karnes on Watson choosing the Nets:

“In the end, Deron had called C.J., Avery had called him... he felt like there was a big hole to fill.”

Jared Karnes on CJ Watson, Jul 14, 2012. Source: Twitter.
